support.contact_subtitle: Our team is ready to help you.
support.faq_1_q: How do I place a food order at a store?
support.faq_1_a: Scan the QR code at the merchant's table or counter, select your favourite food items, and complete payment online. You can also place takeaway orders.
support.faq_2_q: How do I book community services such as Barber or Car Wash?
support.faq_2_a: Open your preferred service store in the Explore tab, select the service package, and choose your preferred date and time. Tap 'Book Now' to confirm your appointment slot.
support.faq_3_q: How do I use store discount vouchers?
support.faq_3_a: During checkout, tap 'Apply Voucher'. You can select from active store vouchers or enter a valid promo code. The discount will be deducted automatically.
support.faq_4_q: What payment methods are supported on Ngam?
support.faq_4_a: Ngam supports fast and secure cashless payments via DuitNow QR, Online Banking FPX, and major Malaysian e-wallets.
support.faq_5_q: How do I track my order or queue status?
support.faq_5_a: You can track your order live via the Order Status Tracker. You will also receive an instant notification when your order is ready or when your turn arrives.
support.faq_6_q: Can I cancel a service booking?
support.faq_6_a: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule via the 'My Bookings' screen at least 1 hour prior to your scheduled appointment.
support.faq_7_q: What is the Digital Loyalty Stamp Card?
support.faq_7_a: Every time you complete an order or service at participating Ngam merchants, you earn a digital stamp to redeem free rewards and perks from that shop.
support.faq_8_q: What if my order is incorrect or has an issue?
support.faq_8_a: You can notify the merchant staff immediately by showing your digital receipt in the Ngam app, or reach out to our customer support team via 'Contact Us'.
support.faq_9_q: Is my personal data and payment secure?
support.faq_9_a: Yes, your security is our priority. All transactions and personal details are protected by high-grade SSL and TLS encryption and processed through licensed Malaysian payment gateways.
support.faq_10_q: How do I register my business as a Ngam Partner?
support.faq_10_a: Merchants can register and manage their store by using the Ngam Business app or visiting our official portal at business.ngam.dev.
